diff --git a/hardware/bbq/generator/bbq_level_lx.py b/hardware/bbq/generator/bbq_level_lx.py
index a038e03..6d86b8f 100644
--- a/hardware/bbq/generator/bbq_level_lx.py
+++ b/hardware/bbq/generator/bbq_level_lx.py
@@ -42,29 +42,693 @@ class BBQLevelLX(BBQLevel):
 
     def latency(self) -> int:
         """Latency in cycles."""
+        if not self.sram_counters and not self.sram_bitmap:
+            return 0
         return 1 + int(self.sram_bitmap) + int(self.sram_counters)
 
 
+    def _priority_idx_slice(self, reg_stage: int) -> str:
+        """Returns the priority bit-slice corresponding to this level."""
+        shift = self.num_bitmap_levels - self.id
+        if shift == 0:
+            return "reg_priority_s[{}][HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0]".format(reg_stage)
+        lo = "{}*HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH".format(shift)
+        hi = "({}*HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH)-1".format(shift + 1)
+        return "reg_priority_s[{}][{}:{}]".format(reg_stage, hi, lo)
+
+
+    def _next_level_idx_slice(self, reg_stage: int) -> str:
+        """Returns the B-bit slice of the next level's address/priority corresponding to this level's index."""
+        if self.is_leaf:
+            return "reg_priority_s[{}][HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0]".format(reg_stage)
+        next_name = self.next_level.name()
+        return "reg_{}_addr_s[{}][HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0]".format(next_name, reg_stage)
+
+
+    def _emit_counter_update(self, cg: CodeGen, new_cnt: str, old_cnt: str, is_enq: str) -> None:
+        """Emits combinational waterlevel counter update."""
+        cg.emit([
+            "{}[WATERLEVEL_IDX-1:0] = ({} ? ({}[WATERLEVEL_IDX-1:0] + 1'b1) : ({}[WATERLEVEL_IDX-1:0] - 1'b1));".format(
+                new_cnt, is_enq, old_cnt, old_cnt),
+            "{}[WATERLEVEL_IDX] = ({} ? ({}[WATERLEVEL_IDX] | {}[0]) : ((|{}[WATERLEVEL_IDX-1:2]) | (&{}[1:0])));".format(
+                new_cnt, is_enq, old_cnt, old_cnt, old_cnt, old_cnt),
+        ])
+
+
+    def _emit_cand_defs(self, cg: CodeGen, prefix: str) -> None:
+        """Emits temporary signal definitions for a fast FFS/postop candidate."""
+        cg.align_defs([
+            ("bitmap_t", "{}_has_lo;".format(prefix)),
+            ("bitmap_t", "{}_has_hi;".format(prefix)),
+            ("bitmap_t", "{}_lsb_oh;".format(prefix)),
+            ("bitmap_t", "{}_msb_oh;".format(prefix)),
+            ("bitmap_t", "{}_lsb_fold;".format(prefix)),
+            ("bitmap_t", "{}_deq_oh;".format(prefix)),
+            ("bitmap_t", "{}_post;".format(prefix)),
+            ("logic [HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0]", "{}_lsb_idx;".format(prefix)),
+            ("logic [HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0]", "{}_msb_idx;".format(prefix)),
+            ("logic [HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0]", "{}_idx;".format(prefix)),
+        ])
+
+
+    def _emit_next_level_defs(self, cg: CodeGen, end_c: int) -> None:
+        """Emits stage definitions at end_cycle for next level interface."""
+        next_name = self.next_level.name()
+        if self.is_leaf:
+            cg.align_defs([
+                ("heap_priority_t", "priority_s{};".format(end_c)),
+            ])
+        else:
+            cg.align_defs([
+                ("logic [BITMAP_L{}_AWIDTH-1:0]".format(self.id + 1),
+                 "{}_addr_s{};".format(next_name, end_c)),
+            ])
+        for offset in range(1, 5):
+            cg.align_defs([
+                ("logic", "{}_addr_conflict_s{}_s{};".format(
+                    next_name, end_c + offset, end_c)),
+                ("logic", "reg_{}_addr_conflict_s{}_s{};".format(
+                    next_name, end_c + offset, end_c)),
+            ])
+            if not self.sram_counters:
+                cg.align_defs([
+                    ("logic [HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0]", "{}_bit_eq_s{}_s{};".format(
+                        next_name, end_c + offset, end_c)),
+                ])
+
+
     def emit_stage_defs(self, cg: CodeGen) -> None:
         """Emit this level through the supplied CodeGen instance."""
-        raise NotImplementedError("Bitmap-level implementation removed")
+        name = self.name()
+        c0 = self.start_cycle + int(self.sram_bitmap)
+        end_c = self.end_cycle
+
+        if self is self.bbq.bitmap_levels[0]:
+            cg.emit([
+                "localparam logic [255:0] FFS_IDX_MASK [0:7] = '{",
+                "    256'hAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA,",
+                "    256'hCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC,",
+                "    256'hF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0,",
+                "    256'hFF00FF00FF00FF00FF00FF00FF00FF00FF00FF00FF00FF00FF00FF00FF00FF00,",
+                "    256'hFFFF0000FFFF0000FFFF0000FFFF0000FFFF0000FFFF0000FFFF0000FFFF0000,",
+                "    256'hFFFFFFFF00000000FFFFFFFF00000000FFFFFFFF00000000FFFFFFFF00000000,",
+                "    256'hFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF0000000000000000FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF0000000000000000,",
+                "    256'hFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF00000000000000000000000000000000",
+                "};",
+            ])
+
+        if self.sram_bitmap:
+            s_bm = self.start_cycle
+            cg.comment("Stage {} metadata (L{} bitmap SRAM read delay)".format(s_bm, self.id))
+            for offset in range(1, 5):
+                cg.align_defs([
+                    ("logic", "reg_{}_addr_conflict_s{}_s{};".format(
+                        name, s_bm + offset, s_bm)),
+                ])
+            cg.emit()
+
+        if not self.sram_counters:
+            # 1-stage level (L1: c0 == end_c)
+            cg.comment("Stage {} metadata".format(end_c))
+            cg.align_defs([
+                ("bitmap_t", "{}_enq_oh_s{};".format(name, end_c)),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{}_op_oh_s{};".format(name, end_c)),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{}_bitmap_s{};".format(name, end_c)),
+                ("bitmap_t", "reg_{}_bitmap_postop_s{};".format(name, c0)),
+                ("logic [HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0]", "{}_idx_s{};".format(name, end_c)),
+                ("counter_t", "old_{}_counter_s{};".format(name, end_c)),
+                ("counter_t", "new_{}_counter_s{};".format(name, end_c)),
+                ("logic", "{}_counter_non_zero_s{};".format(name, end_c)),
+            ])
+            if not self.is_leaf and not self.next_level.sram_bitmap:
+                cg.align_defs([
+                    ("bitmap_t", "{}_next_bm_enq_s{};".format(name, end_c)),
+                    ("bitmap_t", "{}_next_bm_min_s{};".format(name, end_c)),
+                    ("bitmap_t", "{}_next_bm_max_s{};".format(name, end_c)),
+                    ("bitmap_t", "{}_next_bm_read_s{};".format(name, end_c)),
+                ])
+            self._emit_cand_defs(cg, "{}_c0_s{}".format(name, end_c))
+            if self.is_leaf:
+                cg.align_defs([
+                    ("counter_t", "reg_{}_counter_s{};".format(name, end_c)),
+                    ("counter_t", "reg_old_{}_counter_s{};".format(name, end_c)),
+                    ("logic", "reg_{}_counter_non_zero_s{};".format(name, end_c)),
+                ])
+            self._emit_next_level_defs(cg, end_c)
+            cg.emit()
+        else:
+            # 3-stage counter pipeline: c0 (S0), c0+1 (S1), c0+2 = end_c (S2)
+            s0 = c0
+            s1 = c0 + 1
+            s2 = end_c
+
+            cg.comment("Stage {} metadata".format(s0))
+            cg.align_defs([
+                ("bitmap_t", "{}_enq_oh_s{};".format(name, s0)),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{}_cand3_post_s{};".format(name, s0)),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{}_bitmap_postop_s{};".format(name, s0)),
+                ("bitmap_t", "reg_{}_bitmap_postop_s{};".format(name, s0)),
+                ("logic [HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0]", "{}_cand3_idx_s{};".format(name, s0)),
+                ("logic", "{}_d3_take_s2_s{};".format(name, s0)),
+                ("logic [HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0]", "{}_idx_s{};".format(name, s0)),
+                ("logic [HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0]", "reg_{}_idx_s{};".format(name, s0)),
+                ("logic", "reg_{}_c21_both_deq_s{};".format(name, s0)),
+                ("logic", "reg_{}_c21_same_deq_s{};".format(name, s0)),
+                ("logic", "reg_{}_s2_le_s1_s{};".format(name, s0)),
+                ("logic", "reg_{}_s2_ge_s1_s{};".format(name, s0)),
+            ])
+            self._emit_cand_defs(cg, "{}_c0_s{}".format(name, s0))
+            self._emit_cand_defs(cg, "{}_c1_s{}".format(name, s0))
+            self._emit_cand_defs(cg, "{}_c2_s{}".format(name, s0))
+            for offset in range(1, 5):
+                cg.align_defs([
+                    ("logic", "reg_{}_addr_conflict_s{}_s{};".format(
+                        name, s0 + offset, s0)),
+                ])
+            cg.emit()
+
+            cg.comment("Stage {} metadata".format(s1))
+            cg.align_defs([
+                ("logic", "{}_rollback_s{};".format(name, s1)),
+                ("logic", "{}_use_fwd_s2_s{};".format(name, s1)),
+                ("logic", "{}_use_fwd_s3_s{};".format(name, s1)),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{}_b_pre_s{};".format(name, s1)),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{}_bitmap_postop_s{};".format(name, s1)),
+                ("bitmap_t", "reg_{}_bitmap_postop_s{};".format(name, s1)),
+                ("logic [HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0]", "{}_idx_s{};".format(name, s1)),
+                ("logic [HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0]", "reg_{}_idx_s{};".format(name, s1)),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{}_oh_s{};".format(name, s1)),
+                ("bitmap_t", "reg_{}_oh_s{};".format(name, s1)),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{}_s0_oh_s{};".format(name, s1)),
+                ("logic", "{}_postop_zero_s{};".format(name, s1)),
+                ("logic", "reg_{}_postop_zero_s{};".format(name, s1)),
+                ("counter_t", "old_{}_counter_s{};".format(name, s1)),
+                ("counter_t", "reg_old_{}_counter_s{};".format(name, s1)),
+            ])
+            for offset in range(1, 5):
+                cg.align_defs([
+                    ("logic", "reg_{}_addr_conflict_s{}_s{};".format(
+                        name, s1 + offset, s1)),
+                ])
+            cg.emit()
+
+            cg.comment("Stage {} metadata".format(s2))
+            cg.align_defs([
+                ("counter_t", "old_{}_counter_s{};".format(name, s2)),
+                ("counter_t", "new_{}_counter_s{};".format(name, s2)),
+                ("logic", "{}_counter_non_zero_s{};".format(name, s2)),
+                ("logic", "{}_changes_bm_s{};".format(name, s2)),
+                ("bitmap_t", "{}_bitmap_s{};".format(name, s2)),
+                ("counter_t", "reg_{}_counter_s{};".format(name, s2)),
+                ("counter_t", "reg_old_{}_counter_s{};".format(name, s2)),
+                ("logic", "reg_{}_counter_non_zero_s{};".format(name, s2)),
+                ("logic [HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH-1:0]", "reg_{}_idx_s{};".format(name, s2)),
+            ])
+            self._emit_next_level_defs(cg, s2)
+            cg.emit()
 
 
     def emit_state_dependent_combinational_logic(self, cg: CodeGen) -> None:
         """Emit this level through the supplied CodeGen instance."""
-        raise NotImplementedError("Bitmap-level implementation removed")
+        name = self.name()
+        end_c = self.end_cycle
+        seq_c = end_c - 1
+
+        if self.sram_bitmap:
+            cg.emit([
+                "bm_{0}_wren = reg_valid_s[{1}];".format(name, seq_c),
+                "bm_{0}_wraddress = reg_{0}_addr_s[{1}];".format(name, seq_c),
+                "bm_{0}_data = {0}_bitmap_s{2};".format(name, seq_c, end_c),
+            ])
+        if self.sram_counters:
+            addr_expr = ("reg_{0}_idx_s{1}".format(name, seq_c) if self.id == 1 else
+                         "{{reg_{0}_addr_s[{1}], reg_{0}_idx_s{1}}}".format(name, seq_c))
+            cg.emit([
+                "counter_{0}_wren = reg_valid_s[{1}];".format(name, seq_c),
+                "counter_{0}_wraddress = {1};".format(name, addr_expr),
+                "counter_{0}_data = new_{0}_counter_s{2};".format(name, seq_c, end_c),
+            ])
 
 
     def emit_combinational_default_assigns(self, cg: CodeGen) -> None:
         """Emit this level through the supplied CodeGen instance."""
-        raise NotImplementedError("Bitmap-level implementation removed")
+        name = self.name()
+        end_c = self.end_cycle
+        seq_c = end_c - 1
+        next_name = self.next_level.name()
+
+        if not self.sram_counters:
+            addr_expr = "'0"
+        else:
+            addr_expr = ("reg_{0}_idx_s{1}".format(name, seq_c) if self.id == 1 else
+                         "{{reg_{0}_addr_s[{1}], reg_{0}_idx_s{1}}}".format(name, seq_c))
+        if self.is_leaf:
+            cg.emit("priority_s{} = {};".format(end_c, addr_expr))
+        else:
+            cg.emit("{}_addr_s{} = {};".format(next_name, end_c, addr_expr))
+
+
+    def _emit_next_level_comb(self, cg: CodeGen, end_c: int) -> None:
+        """Emits combinational logic at end_cycle driving next level."""
+        name = self.name()
+        seq_c = end_c - 1
+        next_name = self.next_level.name()
+
+        if not self.sram_counters:
+            addr_expr = ("{0}_idx_s{1}".format(name, end_c) if self.id == 1 else
+                         "{{reg_{0}_addr_s[{1}], {0}_idx_s{2}}}".format(name, seq_c, end_c))
+            if self.is_leaf:
+                cg.emit([
+                    "priority_s{0} = {1};".format(end_c, addr_expr),
+                    "pb_rdaddress = priority_s{0};".format(end_c),
+                ])
+            else:
+                cg.emit("{}_addr_s{} = {};".format(next_name, end_c, addr_expr))
+
+        for offset in range(1, 5):
+            other_idx = self._next_level_idx_slice(seq_c + offset)
+            if self.id == 1 and not self.bbq.is_logically_partitioned:
+                parent_match = "reg_valid_s[{}] && reg_valid_s[{}]".format(seq_c, seq_c + offset)
+            else:
+                parent_match = "reg_{}_addr_conflict_s{}_s{}".format(name, seq_c + offset, seq_c)
+            target_conflict = ("pb_addr_conflict_s{}_s{}".format(end_c + offset, end_c)
+                               if self.is_leaf else
+                               "{}_addr_conflict_s{}_s{}".format(next_name, end_c + offset, end_c))
+            if not self.sram_counters:
+                enq_idx = self._priority_idx_slice(seq_c)
+                c0_pref = "{}_c0_s{}".format(name, end_c)
+                bit_eq = "{}_bit_eq_s{}_s{}".format(next_name, end_c + offset, end_c)
+                cg.emit([
+                    "{0} = ~(reg_is_enque_s[{1}] ? ({2} ^ {3}) : (reg_is_deque_min_s[{1}] ? ({4}_lsb_idx ^ {3}) : ({4}_msb_idx ^ {3})));".format(
+                        bit_eq, seq_c, enq_idx, other_idx, c0_pref),
+                    "{0} = ({1} && (&{2}));".format(target_conflict, parent_match, bit_eq),
+                ])
+            else:
+                idx_match = "(reg_{}_idx_s{} == {})".format(name, seq_c, other_idx)
+                cg.emit("{} = ({} && {});".format(target_conflict, parent_match, idx_match))
+
+        if self.is_leaf:
+            cg.emit("pb_rden = reg_valid_s[{}];".format(seq_c))
+            cg.start_conditional("if", "pb_addr_conflict_s{}_s{}".format(
+                self.next_level.end_cycle, end_c))
+            cg.emit([
+                "pb_rdwr_conflict = 1;",
+                "pb_rden = 0;",
+            ])
+            cg.end_conditional("if")
+        elif self.next_level.sram_bitmap:
+            cg.emit([
+                "bm_{0}_rden = reg_valid_s[{1}];".format(next_name, seq_c),
+                "bm_{0}_rdaddress = {0}_addr_s{1};".format(next_name, end_c),
+            ])
+            cg.start_conditional("if", "{}_addr_conflict_s{}_s{}".format(
+                next_name, self.next_level.end_cycle, end_c))
+            cg.emit("bm_{}_rden = 0;".format(next_name))
+            cg.end_conditional("if")
+
+
+    def _emit_multi_cand_ffs(self, cg: CodeGen, cands: list[tuple[str, str, int]],
+                             is_enq: str, is_min: str, enq_idx: str, enq_oh: str) -> None:
+        """Emits flat reduction-OR FFS for W <= 32 and log-W prefix FFS for W > 32."""
+        cg.start_conditional("if", "(HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH <= 16) || ((HEAP_NUM_LEVELS <= 2) && (HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH <= 32))")
+        cg.start_for("j", "j < HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH")
+        for prefix, bm_expr, _ in cands:
+            cg.emit([
+                "{0}_has_lo[j] = |({1} & ((HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH'(1'b1) << j) - 1'b1));".format(
+                    prefix, bm_expr),
+                "{0}_has_hi[j] = |({1} & ~((HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH'(2'd2) << j) - 1'b1));".format(
+                    prefix, bm_expr),
+            ])
+        cg.end_for()
+        cg.end_conditional("if")
+        cg.start_conditional("else if", "HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH <= 32")
+        cg.start_for("j", "j < (HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH / 2)")
+        for prefix, bm_expr, _ in cands:
+            cg.emit([
+                "{0}_has_lo[2*j +: 2] = ({{2{{|({1} & ((HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH'(1'b1) << (2*j)) - 1'b1))}}}} | {{{1}[2*j], 1'b0}});".format(
+                    prefix, bm_expr),
+                "{0}_has_hi[2*j +: 2] = ({{2{{|({1} & ~((HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH'(3'd4) << (2*j)) - 1'b1))}}}} | {{1'b0, {1}[(2*j)+1]}});".format(
+                    prefix, bm_expr),
+            ])
+        cg.end_for()
+        cg.end_conditional("else if")
+        cg.start_conditional("else", None)
+        for prefix, bm_expr, _ in cands:
+            cg.emit([
+                "{0}_has_lo = ({1} << 1);".format(prefix, bm_expr),
+                "{0}_has_hi = ({1} >> 1);".format(prefix, bm_expr),
+            ])
+        cg.start_for("j", "j < HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH")
+        for prefix, _, _ in cands:
+            cg.emit([
+                "{0}_has_lo = ({0}_has_lo | ({0}_has_lo << (1 << j)));".format(prefix),
+                "{0}_has_hi = ({0}_has_hi | ({0}_has_hi >> (1 << j)));".format(prefix),
+            ])
+        cg.end_for()
+        cg.end_conditional("else")
+
+        for prefix, bm_expr, _ in cands:
+            cg.emit([
+                "{0}_lsb_oh = ({1} & (~{0}_has_lo));".format(prefix, bm_expr),
+                "{0}_msb_oh = ({1} & (~{0}_has_hi));".format(prefix, bm_expr),
+                "{0}_deq_oh = ({1} & ({2} ? (~{0}_has_lo) : (~{0}_has_hi)));".format(
+                    prefix, bm_expr, is_min),
+                "{0}_post = ({1} ? ({2} | {3}) : ({2} & ({4} ? {0}_has_lo : {0}_has_hi)));".format(
+                    prefix, is_enq, bm_expr, enq_oh, is_min),
+                "{0}_lsb_fold = {{~{0}_has_lo[HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-1], {0}_lsb_oh[HEAP_BITMAP_WIDTH-2:0]}};".format(
+                    prefix),
+            ])
+
+        cg.start_for("j", "j < HEAP_LOG_BITMAP_WIDTH")
+        for prefix, _, _ in cands:
+            cg.emit([
+                "{0}_lsb_idx[j] = |({0}_lsb_fold & bitmap_t'(FFS_IDX_MASK[j]));".format(prefix),
+                "{0}_msb_idx[j] = |({0}_msb_oh & bitmap_t'(FFS_IDX_MASK[j]));".format(prefix),
+            ])
+        cg.end_for()
+
+        for prefix, _, _ in cands:
+            cg.emit("{0}_idx = ({1} ? {2} : ({3} ? {0}_lsb_idx : {0}_msb_idx));".format(
+                prefix, is_enq, enq_idx, is_min))
 
 
     def emit_state_agnostic_combinational_logic(self, cg: CodeGen) -> None:
         """Emit this level through the supplied CodeGen instance."""

+
